effects.printed_clause: While controlling Azrynior, Tribute a Protogenic Token, target a monster destroyed by the opponent's card effect this turn; revive it and all other monsters destroyed by the opponent's cards this turn sharing Type, Attribute, Level, ATK or DEF. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Adversarial re-review confirmed that the current canonical Lua implements this printed effect with supported Omega primitives. A compound effect need not have a single-card official analogue; the attached official references validate its individual engine structures.

official_references.matched_structure: Compares monster Type, Attribute, Level, ATK and DEF as independent characteristics.
official_references.official_effect_text: Reveal 1 monster in your hand, choose 1 monster from your Deck that has exactly 1 of the same Type, Attribute, Level, ATK or DEF, [b]and[/b] [b]banish[/b] the revealed monster from your hand face-down. [b]Then[/b] add, from the Deck to your hand, 1 monster that has exactly 1 of the same Type, Attribute, Level, ATK or DEF as the monster chosen from your Deck, [b]and[/b] [b]banish[/b] the card chosen from the Deck face-down. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Small World" [b]per turn[/b].

official_references.matched_structure: Tracks destruction by card effect and performs a delayed follow-up.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Once[/b] [b]per turn[/b], during the next [b]Standby Phase[/b] after this card was destroyed by card effect [b]and[/b] sent to the GY: Special Summon this card from the GY. If you do: [b]Destroy[/b] all other monsters on the field. [b]When[/b] this card is destroyed by battle [b]and[/b] sent to the GY: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon 1 "Fire King" monster from your Deck, except "Fire King High Avatar Garunix".
